extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorate heads and office budget/reporting staff (Directors of Communications, Finance, Logistics, Medical Services, Personnel, Security, Training, Chief Support Services Staff, DD/S Plans Staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA guidance for preparing and submitting reports required by OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), specifying deadlines, reporting periods, required sections, scope limits, and forthcoming standard forms/instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report submission deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: The first report to be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff no later than 21 December 1970; the first full report will be submitted so as to reach the Executive Director-Comptroller on 30 June 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial (partial) report due 21 December 1970; first full (all sections) report due to Executive Director-Comptroller 30 June 1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report coverage period
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial report covers the period of time between 1 January and 30 June 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This initial report should include nothing at all regarding FY 1970 because the data was not included when the last budget went forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Section I, 'Management Effectiveness Goals,' and Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals,' are the only sections to be included in the initial report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No uniformity (standard form/instructions) is needed for the first report.

rubrics_metrics.name: First full report coverage and content
rubrics_metrics.description: The first full report will contain all four sections and will cover the period 1 July 1971 - 30 June 1972.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The first full report is to be submitted so as to reach the Executive Director-Comptroller on 30 June 1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report scope limited to office budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Your reports should be limited to your own Office's budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is necessary in order to avoid confusion as to who claims what savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation of uniform form and instructions for June 30 report
rubrics_metrics.description: A form and set of instructions will be prepared for the 30 June 1971 report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that while the first (Dec 21) report need not be uniform, standardized forms/instructions will be provided for the subsequent full report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectation to modify reporting to fit normal budget submittals
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hoped that the reporting instructions can, at some future date, be modified to permit inclusion of the information called for in the annual report in the normal budget submittals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Longer-term objective is to integrate these reporting requirements into standard budget submission processes when feasible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Necessity of initial report due to missing prior budget data
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial report is necessary because the data was not included when the last budget went forward.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit initial report to capture data omitted from prior budget cycle for the specified interim period (1 Jan–30 Jun 1971).
